cohort: Singleton and twin neonates born between 24(0/7) and 33(6/7) weeks' gestational age admitted to tertiary neonatal units in Canada between 2010 and 2014
finding: Administration of a complete course of antenatal corticosteroids 1-7 days before birth in both twin and singleton pregnancies was associated with similar reductions in neonatal mortality, short-term respiratory morbidity, and severe neurological injury.
